tiles.name: 1. Sends failed (count — send.result failed; empty is healthy)

select.where: ServiceName = 'email-gateway' AND Body = 'ses.event' AND LogAttributes['event_type'] IN ('Bounce','Complaint')

tiles.name: 2. Bounces and complaints (count — ses.event Bounce/Complaint; empty is healthy)
3. Jobs failed (count — terminal job.failed; empty is healthy)
4. Mailbox sync ok (count — sync.tick ok; 0 in 1h means sync stalled)
5. SES sending paused (count — ses.account sending_enabled=false; empty is healthy)
6. LLM lane erroring (count — llm.call not ok)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) d, LogAttributes['template'] template, LogAttributes['status'] status, count() n
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE ServiceName = 'email-gateway' AND Body='send.result' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY d, template, status ORDER BY d DESC, n DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT toStartOfDay(Timestamp) d, LogAttributes['event_type'] event, LogAttributes['bounce_type'] bounce_type, count() n
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE ServiceName = 'email-gateway' AND Body='ses.event' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY d, event, bounce_type ORDER BY d DESC, n DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.name: 8. SES events (7d) — bounce / complaint rate source

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT Timestamp, LogAttributes['sending_enabled'] sending_enabled, LogAttributes['sent_24h'] sent_24h, LogAttributes['max_24h_send'] max_24h, LogAttributes['headroom_pct'] headroom_pct
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE ServiceName = 'email-gateway' AND Body='ses.account' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT SpanAttributes['job.kind'] kind, count() runs,
       countIf(SpanAttributes['outcome']='error') errors,
       countIf(SpanAttributes['outcome']='rate_limited') rate_limited,
       round(quantile(0.95)(Duration)/1e9,2) p95_s
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE ServiceName='email-gateway' AND SpanName LIKE 'job.%' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY kind ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 20

tiles.name: 10. Jobs by kind — runs, failures, p95 (7d)

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT LogAttributes['provider'] provider, LogAttributes['mailbox'] mailbox, count() ticks,
       countIf(LogAttributes['outcome']='ok') ok, max(Timestamp) last_tick,
       sum(toUInt32OrZero(LogAttributes['ingested'])) ingested
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE ServiceName = 'email-gateway' AND Body='sync.tick' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY provider, mailbox ORDER BY last_tick DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT LogAttributes['lane'] lane, count() calls,
       countIf(LogAttributes['outcome']!='ok') errors,
       round(quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['latency_ms']))/1000,1) p50_s,
       round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['latency_ms']))/1000,1) p95_s
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE ServiceName = 'email-gateway' AND Body='llm.call' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY lane ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT SpanAttributes['http.route'] route, count() n,
       countIf(toUInt16OrZero(SpanAttributes['http.response.status_code'])>=500) s5xx,
       round(quantile(0.95)(Duration)/1e9,2) p95_s
FROM $__sourceTable
WHERE ServiceName='email-gateway' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY route ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 30
